tide_sheathe.note: Tidecrest: the katana slid home at the left hip, the right hand pinned on the hilt at the seat frame (Mixamo Sheathing Sword at its seat, 1.27 s)
tide_sheathe.prompt: A person slowly sheathes a sword at their left hip, sliding the blade back into the scabbard with the right hand.

dust_spin_holster.note: Dust: a gun spin on the trigger finger, then into the right-hip holster (the hand pinned at the holster: Mixamo Pistol Aim to holster idle at 3.6 s)
dust_spin_holster.prompt: A person spins a pistol around their trigger finger, then drops it into the holster on their right hip.

victim_stagger_fall.note: a victim's stagger and fall (no pins)
victim_stagger_fall.prompt: A person is hit hard, staggers backwards and falls down onto their back.

silly_hiphop_loop.note: one silly hip-hop dance loop (a free pass, then each take pinned to its own first pose at both ends)
silly_hiphop_loop.prompt: A person does a silly hip hop dance.
